name: Australia Aboriginal land permits (NT land trusts, APY Lands SA, WA reserves) (class)
rule_summary: Entering Aboriginal land without a land-council permit is an offence (Aboriginal Land Act (NT); APY Land Rights Act 1981 (SA)).
notes: NLC and SA legislation appeared in search results but were not read; nt.gov.au returned 403. APY Lands is a named local-government-level area (~103,000 km2) - closest to a named unit.

name: Lord Howe Island
rule_summary: Tourist numbers capped at 400 by limiting licensed beds; no entry decision on persons.
notes: Negative: capacity regulation of accommodation, not a visitor-entry rule.

name: Torres Strait Protected Zone
rule_summary: Traditional inhabitants of 13 PNG treaty villages may enter the Protected Zone without passport or visa for traditional activities.
notes: DFAT page timed out. Zone defined by treaty coordinates and listed islands.

name: Azerbaijan 'liberated territories' (Shusha, Lachin, Aghdam, Fuzuli, Khojaly, Khankendi)
rule_summary: From 2025-07-23 foreigners may visit only with a permit (Yolumuz Qarabağa portal, accredited hotel or licensed tour).
affected_classes: all foreign nationals; citizens also need permits
notes: State portal read. Before July 2025 foreigners were essentially not admitted.

name: Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic
rule_summary: Iranian citizens may enter Nakhchivan without a visa for 15 days; onward travel to the rest of Azerbaijan needs a visa issued at Nakhchivan airport.
notes: Azernews only; current status (post-2020 land-border closure) not verified. For other nationalities the national (e-)visa applies - negative.

name: Chittagong Hill Tracts (Rangamati, Khagrachhari, Bandarban districts)
rule_summary: Foreigners need prior permission from the district administration (via local operator) to enter the three hill districts.
notes: Sources: Wikivoyage, Daily Star ('Restrictions in CHT to go'), forum posts. No official text read. Three whole districts.

name: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba
rule_summary: One common Caribbean-Netherlands visa policy applies to all three islands.
notes: Negative: no differential found between the three islands of BQ.

name: Fernando de Noronha
rule_summary: Visitors pay a per-day Environmental Preservation Tax (TPA); stay beyond the scheduled period needs prior authorisation of the district administration and is charged double.
notes: Mostly a tax. The 'authorised stay' wording makes it borderline stay control; state law not read. No fixed legal max stay found.

name: Brazil indigenous lands (class)
rule_summary: Entry into any indigenous land requires FUNAI authorisation (Lei 14.701/2023; IN 3/2015 for tourism visitation plans).
affected_classes: all non-indigenous persons, citizens and foreigners
notes: FUNAI page read. Land-tenure access rule, not immigration; c. 13% of Brazil.

name: Bhutan border towns (Phuentsholing, Gelephu, Samdrup Jongkhar)
rule_summary: Indian citizens may move freely within the border towns; travel beyond needs an entry permit (and SDF).
notes: Effectively: rest of Bhutan is permit territory for Indians; the free part is a short list of towns.

name: Brest-Grodno tourism and recreation zone
rule_summary: Citizens of listed countries may stay 15 days visa-free inside listed districts of Brest and Grodno regions with an agency document, and may not leave the zone.
notes: Official portal read (summarising fetch). Scope = list of districts (Brest city + 4 districts; Grodno city + 7 districts), not whole oblasts. Largely overtaken by broader 30-day waivers but still in force.

name: Rapa Nui (Easter Island)
rule_summary: Non-residents (including Chileans) are limited to a 30-day stay and must show an entry form, return ticket and accommodation.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Details (Ley 21.070, 30 days) are from the earlier sample/own knowledge, not checked here. Evidence from the 2026-09-24 review, Appendix C: Chilean government notice on Law 21.070 (msgg.gob.cl).

name: China 240-hour visa-free transit stay areas
rule_summary: Eligible transit passengers may stay 240 h without a visa but only inside listed provinces/cities.
affected_classes: 55-odd eligible nationalities in transit to a third country
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Artefact class: transit rule with a permitted-stay area list (24 province-level units, some partial).

name: China cruise-group visa waiver (coastal provinces + Beijing)
rule_summary: Cruise tour groups may stay 15 days visa-free within coastal provinces and Beijing.
affected_classes: all nationalities in cruise tour groups
notes: Area-list artefact.

name: Guilin ASEAN tour-group visa waiver
rule_summary: ASEAN tour groups may stay 6 days visa-free in Guilin only, entering via Guilin airport.
affected_classes: ASEAN nationals in approved tour groups

name: Hainan Province
rule_summary: Nationals of 59 countries may enter Hainan visa-free for 30 days and must stay within the province; foreign tour groups from HK/Macau get 144 h in Hainan.
affected_classes: 59 listed nationalities; HK/Macau-organised foreign tour groups
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Wikipedia cites NIA notice (nia.gov.cn) for the 2024-07-30 144-hour group policy.

name: Hengqin (Guangdong-Macao In-Depth Cooperation Zone)
rule_summary: No Hengqin-only visitor entry regime found; Hengqin port was added to the 240-hour transit port list (2024-12-17).
notes: Lead not confirmed: the 'second-line' regime of Hengqin is customs; multi-entry Macau-Hengqin group arrangements for mainland residents were not investigated.

name: Pearl River Delta 144-hour group visa-free area
rule_summary: Tour groups organised in HK/Macau may stay 6 days visa-free within ten listed Guangdong cities.
affected_classes: nationals of states with PRC diplomatic relations, in HK/Macau-organised groups
notes: City list (Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Foshan, Dongguan, Zhongshan, Jiangmen, Zhaoqing, Huizhou, Shantou).

name: Shenzhen, Zhuhai and Xiamen SEZ visas on arrival
rule_summary: A port visa valid only for the single city (5 days Shenzhen, 3 days Zhuhai/Xiamen).
affected_classes: most nationalities, minus an exclusion list
notes: Each visa is scoped to a named prefecture-level city.

name: Tibet Autonomous Region
rule_summary: Foreigners need a Tibet Travel Permit, checked on boarding transport to Tibet.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census.

name: Xishuangbanna ASEAN tour-group visa waiver
rule_summary: ASEAN tour groups may stay 6 days visa-free in Xishuangbanna only.
affected_classes: ASEAN nationals in approved tour groups
notes: Xinhua 2025-02-10 cited by Wikipedia.

name: Leticia (Amazonas)
rule_summary: Visitors pay a tourist card/fee on arrival at Leticia airport.
notes: Municipal tourist tax, not an admission decision.

name: Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina
rule_summary: Every non-resident, Colombians included, needs an OCCRE tourist card to enter; tourist stay is capped at 4 months per year.
notes: Decree text (suin-juriscol / occre.gov.co) could not be fetched (TLS error). Strong CR-W analogue of Rapa Nui/Galápagos.

name: Northern Cyprus (TRNC)
rule_summary: Own entry regime: free visa on arrival for 90/180 days for almost all nationalities; e-visa for some; ID-card entry for EU/Turkey; Republic of Cyprus treats entry via northern ports as illegal.

name: Akrotiri and Dhekelia (UK Sovereign Base Areas)
rule_summary: Short visits follow Cyprus's visa policy with open land boundaries; stays over 28 days need a permit; SBA crossings to the north (Pergamos, Strovilia) are controlled by SBA authorities.
notes: No ISO 3166-1 code of its own; 'CY' here is a placeholder, legally UK territory. Effectively negative for short-stay visitors.

name: Büsingen am Hochrhein
rule_summary: In Swiss customs territory; no immigration differential.
notes: Negative control.

name: Heligoland
rule_summary: Outside EU customs union and VAT area; no immigration differential.
notes: Negative control.

name: Algeria 'Great South' wilayas (regularisation visa on arrival)
rule_summary: Tourists whose trip to the southern wilayas is organised by an accredited Algerian agency get a visa on arrival instead of a consular visa.
affected_classes: all foreign tourists using an accredited agency
notes: Embassy (MFA) announcement read: 'exceptional and temporary'. Scope = list of southern wilayas (c. 24), itinerary-based; extension to all wilayas proposed Dec 2024 (unverified).

name: Galápagos Province
rule_summary: All visitors must obtain a Transit Control Card (TCT); tourist stay is capped (60 days per year per earlier sample).
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Wikipedia confirms only the TCT requirement; stay cap not re-verified.

name: South Sinai resorts (Sharm El Sheikh, Dahab, Nuweiba, Taba)
rule_summary: A free 15-day entry permission stamp replaces the visa if the visitor stays within the Sinai resort strip; it is not valid for the rest of Egypt.
affected_classes: EU, UK, US citizens per Egyptian consulate; per Timatic all nationalities except a long exclusion list, arriving at Sharm/St Catherine/Taba airports
notes: Scope is a coastal resort strip (Aqaba coast + St Catherine), not South Sinai Governorate as a whole. Two sources (consulate vs Timatic) disagree on who is eligible.

name: Polisario-controlled Western Sahara east of the berm
rule_summary: Access only with Polisario/SADR authorisation via Tindouf (Algeria); the Moroccan-controlled part uses Moroccan entry rules.
notes: EH has its own ISO code; this is a split inside EH. No source with actual entry rules found; hostilities since Nov 2020.

name: Eritrea outside Asmara
rule_summary: Foreigners need a travel permit for any travel outside the capital.
notes: Wikivoyage; US State Dept page appeared in results but was not read. Inverse scope (everything except one city).

name: Canary Islands
rule_summary: Outside EU VAT area (IGIC); inside Schengen with no special visitor regime.
notes: Negative control.

name: Ceuta
rule_summary: Moroccan residents of Tetouan province are visa-exempt for Ceuta only; Spain keeps document checks on departures from Ceuta to the rest of Schengen.
affected_classes: Moroccans resident in Tetouan province; visa-required nationals on limited visas
notes: EUR-Lex (Schengen Borders Code Art. 41; Declaration OJ L 239, 22.9.2000, p. 69) could not be fetched. Reported de facto suspension of the local exemption after the 2022 border reopening - unverified.

name: Melilla
rule_summary: Moroccan residents of Nador province are visa-exempt for Melilla only; checks on departure to the rest of Schengen.
notes: Same as Ceuta.

name: Åland
rule_summary: Outside EU VAT area; no immigration differential for visitors.
notes: Negative control. Note Åland has its own ISO 3166-1 code AX, so it is out of scope anyway.

name: Clipperton Island
rule_summary: Landing and stay need prior authorisation of the High Commissioner in French Polynesia / overseas minister (Décret 2023-1182; arrêté of 2025-11-03).
notes: Légifrance arrêté of 2008-02-03 read: only delegates administration. Access-authorisation decree not read. Clipperton has no ISO 3166-1 entry (CP is exceptionally reserved); uninhabited.

name: Abkhazia
rule_summary: Own entry permit/visa unless exempt; Georgia penalises entry from Russia.

name: South Ossetia
rule_summary: No visas, but prior approval/invitation from South Ossetian authorities is needed; entry only via Russia.

name: Greek Aegean islands 'express visa' for Turkish citizens
rule_summary: Turkish citizens get a 7-day visa at the port valid only for the island of entry among 12 listed islands (Lesbos, Chios, Samos, Kos, Rhodes, Limnos, Leros, Kalymnos, Kastellorizo, Symi, Patmos, Samothrace).
affected_classes: Turkish citizens and family arriving by sea
notes: Extended to April 2027 per GTP 2026-04-01. Greek MFA page returned 403. Each named island is the scope of one visa.

name: Mount Athos
rule_summary: Entry needs a special permit (diamonitirion); women are not admitted.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census.

name: Batam, Bintan and Karimun
rule_summary: Singapore permanent residents may enter the three islands visa-free for 4 days.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census.

name: Indonesian Papua interior (Surat Keterangan Jalan)
rule_summary: Foreigners need a police travel permit (SKJ) to travel beyond the main towns (Jayapura, Sorong/Raja Ampat, Biak).
notes: Tour-operator/forum sources only; no regulation located.

name: Andaman and Nicobar Islands
rule_summary: Restricted Area Permit regime; since 2018, 30 inhabited islands no longer need RAP for foreigners, the rest (incl. tribal reserves, Nicobar) still do.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Since 2018 the rule is no longer whole-territory: 'Parts of Andaman and Nicobar Islands'.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
rule_summary: Foreigners need a Protected Area Permit for the whole state; non-resident Indians need an Inner Line Permit.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Wikipedia (citing MHA Annex VII of 2018-02-01): 'Whole of Arunachal Pradesh'.

name: Ladakh protected areas (Nubra, Pangong, Tso Moriri, Dah-Hanu etc.)
rule_summary: Foreigners need a Protected Area Permit (group of 2+, via agent, max 15 days) for listed border valleys; Leh, Kargil and main highways are open.
affected_classes: all foreigners (Indians no longer need ILP since 2021 per guides)
notes: Official leh.nic.in page returned 404. Parts only; Wikipedia lists 'Parts of Ladakh' as formerly protected - partial conflict on label, not on practice.

name: Lakshadweep
rule_summary: Entry permit needed for all non-islanders; foreigners reportedly need a Restricted Area Permit and may visit only Agatti, Bangaram and Kadmat.
affected_classes: all non-residents incl. Indians; foreigners more restricted
since: 1967 (Laccadive ... Restriction on Entry and Residence Rules)
notes: CONFLICT: Wikipedia's PAP/RAP page lists 'All of Lakshadweep' under FORMERLY protected/restricted areas, while Wikipedia 'Visa policy of India' says 'Special permits are needed to enter Lakshadweep' and 2025 travel-agency guides describe an entry permit (epermit.utl.gov.in) for everyone. Likely both true: RAP order lifted but the UT entry-permit regulation remains. Official page not read.

name: Manipur
rule_summary: Whole state is a Protected Area for foreigners (relaxed 2011-2012 onward, re-imposed per later MHA orders); ILP for Indians since 2019.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Regime toggled: excluded from PAP 2010-12-30 onward by yearly relaxations; current status after the 2024 re-imposition not verified here.

name: Minicoy (Lakshadweep)
rule_summary: Maldivian citizens may visit Minicoy for 15 days with permission of the Indian High Commission in Malé.
notes: Wikipedia cites a cruising blog (2017) only.

name: Mizoram
rule_summary: Whole state Protected Area for foreigners (with relaxations); ILP for Indians.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Same toggle as Manipur.

name: Nagaland
rule_summary: Whole state Protected Area for foreigners (with relaxations); ILP for Indians.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Same toggle as Manipur.

name: India: protected areas in parts of Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, Jammu and Kashmir
rule_summary: PAP needed for border belts inside these states.
notes: Band class (inner line); not whole units.

name: Sikkim
rule_summary: Whole state is partly Protected and partly Restricted Area; foreigners need a permit.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. 'Whole of Sikkim (partly in Protected Area and partly in Restricted Area)'.

name: Kurdistan Region of Iraq
rule_summary: KRG ran its own visa/e-visa (visit.gov.krd) valid only for the Region; a federal visa is valid everywhere.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. FLAG: Wikipedia says that as of September 2025 the federal e-Visa portal is 'solely responsible' for visas incl. Kurdistan (source: Baghdad Today, Council of Ministers decision); the same page still describes a KRG e-visa. Needs re-check before relying on this row.

name: Kish Island Free Zone
rule_summary: Tourists may stay 14 days on Kish without any visa.
affected_classes: all tourists (US/UK/Canada citizens need an escort guide)
notes: Wikipedia sourcing is a travel agency page dated 2022; no official Iranian source read.

name: Iran mainland free zones (Chabahar, Aras, Anzali, Arvand, Maku)
rule_summary: Same 14-day visa-free stay within each listed free trade zone.
notes: Zones are parcels, not admin units; practical availability unverified.

name: Qeshm Island Free Zone
rule_summary: Tourists may stay 14 days on Qeshm without any visa.
notes: Same source as Kish.

name: Livigno
rule_summary: Outside EU customs territory and VAT; no immigration differential.
notes: Negative control. (Campione d'Italia joined the EU customs territory in 2020.)

name: Sicily
rule_summary: Ordinary Italian region; no entry differential.
notes: Negative control; no source needed beyond absence of any special regime (absence is not proof).

name: Aqaba Special Economic Zone (ASEZA)
rule_summary: Visitors entering through, or registering within 48 h in, the Aqaba zone get the entry visa free of charge.
affected_classes: nationalities eligible for visa on arrival
notes: Only forum/blog sources found; Wikipedia 'Visa policy of Jordan' does not mention it; visitjordan.com page had no visa text. Effect is a fee waiver, not a different admission decision -> classed as fee-only.

name: Rason Special Economic Zone
rule_summary: Visitors enter on a Rason entry permit instead of a DPRK visa; the permit is valid only for the zone.
affected_classes: all nationalities except US and ROK citizens
notes: NK News Jan 2025 (reopening); tourism was halted again weeks later per background knowledge - status unclear.

name: Sinuiju day-trip zone
rule_summary: Day trips from Dandong to Sinuiju without a visa.
affected_classes: Chinese tour groups; others via agencies
notes: Dead link in source; post-2020 status unknown.

name: Jeju Province
rule_summary: Most ordinary-passport holders otherwise needing a Korean visa may stay 30 days visa-free in Jeju Province only, arriving on direct international flights to Jeju.
affected_classes: nationals needing a visa for mainland Korea (minus an exclusion list)
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Wikipedia text seen: 'Jeju Visa Waiver Program ... stay without a visa for 30 days in Jeju Province'; K-ETA now required.

name: Jeolla provinces + Jeju (Muan airport group waiver)
rule_summary: Tour groups arriving at Muan airport may stay 15 days visa-free in South Jeolla, North Jeolla and Jeju.
notes: Muan airport closed after the Dec 2024 crash (background knowledge) - status unclear.

name: Gangwon Province + Seoul metropolitan area (Yangyang airport group waiver)
rule_summary: Tour groups from listed countries arriving at Yangyang airport may stay 15 days visa-free in Gangwon and the Seoul metropolitan area.
affected_classes: tour groups from listed SE Asian countries and Mongolia
notes: Yearly-renewed pilot; airport operations uncertain.

name: Baikonur (city and cosmodrome)
rule_summary: Russian-administered closed city: entry needs a pass obtained in advance through accredited agencies/Roscosmos.
notes: Applies to Kazakh citizens too. Site-level.

name: Golden Triangle Special Economic Zone (Bokeo)
rule_summary: Visitors crossing from Chiang Saen reportedly need no Lao visa if they stay inside the zone; the checkpoint also issues visas on arrival.
notes: Hitchwiki/blog claims; Lao immigration site lists the checkpoint as an international VOA point. Unresolved.

name: Lebanon south of the Litani River
rule_summary: Foreigners need a Lebanese Army permit (issued in Saida) to travel south of the Litani.
notes: Forum-level evidence only; area is in a post-war security situation.

name: Eastern Libya (Benghazi-based government)
rule_summary: The eastern government issues its own entry decisions (e.g. visa-free for Belarusians landing at Benghazi only, May 2025).
affected_classes: Belarus citizens; generally all visitors (separate security approval)
notes: Evidence is one nationality-specific measure; boundary of control is not a named unit.

name: Transnistria
rule_summary: Own checkpoints issue a migration card (45 days); since 2023-04-01 Ukrainian men 18-60 need MGB permission.
notes: No visa; a separate control line and stay document.

name: Wa State
rule_summary: Reported to require a Wa travel pass at its own border gates; Myanmar visas reportedly not what is checked.
notes: Only a Quora answer found. Unresolved.

name: Mexico northern border 'free zone'
rule_summary: Former practice: no FMM needed within ~20-30 km of the US border for stays under 72 h; reported ended in 2015.
notes: Blog sources; some still claim the exemption. Listed as a dropped lead.

name: Mexico southern border states (Regional Visitor Card)
rule_summary: Nationals/permanent residents of Guatemala, Belize, El Salvador and Honduras may visit Campeche, Chiapas, Tabasco, Quintana Roo and Yucatán for up to 7 days per entry on a TVR, without a visa; not valid elsewhere.
affected_classes: nationals and permanent residents of GT, BZ, SV, HN
notes: INM page read (published 2022-03-03). Scope = five whole named states: a clean CR-W-type rule that would split Mexico by state group.

name: Labuan
rule_summary: Federal territory inside the East Malaysian immigration regime (earlier sample).
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census.

name: Sabah
rule_summary: Separate state immigration control: arrivals from Peninsular Malaysia, including Malaysians, pass immigration and get a separate stay permission.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census.  Evidence from the 2026-09-24 review, Appendix C: Immigration Department of Malaysia page on internal travel documents.

name: Sarawak
rule_summary: Separate state immigration control with its own stay permission, also for Malaysians from other states.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census.  Evidence from the 2026-09-24 review, Appendix C: Immigration Department of Malaysia page on internal travel documents.

name: Nepal restricted trekking areas (Upper Mustang, Upper Dolpo, Manaslu, Humla, etc.)
rule_summary: Foreigners need a special trekking permit from the Department of Immigration for 15 listed restricted zones.
notes: Nepal Tourism Board page read. Zones are defined by wards of rural municipalities, not districts. Solo-trekker rule reportedly dropped 2026-03-22 (operator blogs).

name: Autonomous Region of Bougainville
rule_summary: No separate immigration control or permit; a PNG visa covers Bougainville.
notes: Negative for now; independence process ongoing.

name: Azad Jammu and Kashmir
rule_summary: NOC for foreigners was abolished on 2019-03-26 except within 5 miles of the Line of Control; travel guides still tell foreigners to get an NOC from the AJK Home Department.
notes: CONFLICT between 2019 federal notification (Dawn, Tribune) and 2025-26 operator guidance. Not an ISO-internal unit in everyone's view (disputed territory).

name: Gilgit-Baltistan
rule_summary: Declared non-restricted in 2019; permits remain only for border bands (10 mi from China/Afghan borders, 5 mi from LoC, Siachen).
notes: After 2019 the rule is a border band, not the unit.

name: Gaza Strip
rule_summary: Entry to Gaza is controlled separately from the West Bank (Hamas/Israel/Egypt permits).
notes: Split inside ISO entry PS. Since Oct 2023 an emergency situation - arguably outside 'standing non-emergency rule'.

name: Azores
rule_summary: EU outermost region; no entry differential.
notes: Negative control.

name: Madeira
rule_summary: EU outermost region; no entry differential.
notes: Negative control.

name: Kosovo
rule_summary: Own visa policy and border control; Serbia may refuse entry from Kosovo to travellers who entered Kosovo from a third country.
notes: Not in ISO 3166-1 (XK is user-assigned); placing it under RS is a modelling choice, not an ISO fact.

name: Russia 72-hour visa-free for ferry/cruise passengers
rule_summary: Passengers arriving by ferry/cruise at listed ports may stay 72 h visa-free within the port city under organised programmes.
notes: Port-list artefact; practical operation after 2022 unverified.

name: Russia border security zone (incl. Kurils, parts of Sakhalin, Arctic coast)
rule_summary: A band along the state border requires an FSB pass; foreigners must apply ~30 days ahead; on the Kurils only Yuzhno-Kurilsk, Mendeleyevo airport and Shikotan villages are reported exempt.
notes: Band class; covers whole small units (e.g. Kuril districts) in effect.

name: Chukotka Autonomous Okrug
rule_summary: The okrug is a 'territory with regulated entry for foreign visitors': foreigners need an FSB-coordinated authorisation plus a border-zone pass.
notes: Official okrug government memo read (via summarising fetch). Wikipedia's rendering of Decree 470 says 'all except Bilibino region', so strictly not 100% of the unit. Only Russian federal subject restricted (almost) as a whole.

name: Chukotka (Alaska Native visa-free travel)
rule_summary: Indigenous Alaska residents with relatives in Chukotka may enter Chukotka visa-free for up to 90 days on invitation.
notes: Status after 2022 not verified.

name: Russia: territories with regulated access for foreigners (Decree 470), other than Chukotka
rule_summary: Parts of ~17 federal subjects (Kamchatka, Primorye, Krasnoyarsk incl. Norilsk, Murmansk, Karelia, Arkhangelsk, Kaliningrad ~15%, North Ossetia ~45%, Yamal etc.) need FSB-coordinated permission.
notes: Decree text (base.garant.ru/104408) not read. Parts of units only.

name: Russia former regional e-visas (Far East, Kaliningrad, St Petersburg/Leningrad Oblast)
rule_summary: Regional e-visas valid only for the named federal subjects existed 2017-2020 and were replaced by a nationwide unified e-visa.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Current page describes only the unified e-visa; the regional scheme was not re-verified here.

name: Kaliningrad Oblast restricted districts (Baltiysk, Vistula Spit, parts of others)
rule_summary: Listed towns/districts are closed to foreigners without permission; transit on railways/highways is exempt.
notes: Regional tourist information centre page read; sub-case of Decree 470.

name: Saatse Boot road (Värska-Ulitina)
rule_summary: Transit by vehicle through ~1 km of Russian territory without border control; stopping or walking forbidden.
notes: Transit artefact; Estonia has been building a bypass - current status unverified.

name: Saimaa Canal (Russian section)
rule_summary: No Russian visa needed to pass the Russian part of the canal without leaving the vessel.
notes: Transit artefact; traffic largely stopped after 2022.

name: Russia closed cities (ZATO)
rule_summary: Entry to closed administrative-territorial formations needs special authorisation for anyone not resident there; foreigners need additional clearance.
notes: Non-territory-unit class (c. 38 ZATO). Applies to Russian citizens too, so not only an immigration rule.

name: Mecca (haram boundary)
rule_summary: Non-Muslims may not enter Mecca; in Medina only the Prophet's Mosque precinct is closed to them.
notes: Class defined by religion, not nationality; a presence prohibition rather than a permit. Medina city reportedly opened to non-Muslims (2021-2023) - secondary only.

name: Ascension Island
rule_summary: All nationalities, British citizens included, need an Ascension e-visa in advance; no visa on arrival; several nationalities not issued visas.
notes: AIG e-visa FAQ read.

name: Saint Helena
rule_summary: Own regime: visa-free for a long list of nationalities, entry permit on arrival.
notes: Three parts of ISO SH have three regimes.

name: Tristan da Cunha
rule_summary: All visitors need prior approval of the Administrator / Island Council to land.
notes: Tristan Government & Association site read.

name: Jan Mayen
rule_summary: Access requires permission from Norwegian authorities (earlier sample); Svalbard, in the same ISO entry SJ, is visa-free.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. See sj-svalbard: one ISO code, two regimes.

name: Svalbard
rule_summary: Entirely visa-free for all nationalities; Schengen visa needed only to transit mainland Norway.
notes: ISO SJ = Svalbard + Jan Mayen: two different regimes inside one ISO entry.

name: Puntland
rule_summary: Puntland rejects the federal e-visa (Sept 2025) and charges its own USD 60 visa on arrival; launched own visa system Nov 2025.
notes: Federal member state, not a secessionist entity; new since 2025. Sources: Hiiraan, Garowe Online, Somali Guardian.

name: Somaliland
rule_summary: Completely separate visa policy; visa on arrival at Hargeisa/Berbera airports; Somali federal visas/e-visas not recognised.
notes: Israel recognised Somaliland in Dec 2025 (from background knowledge, not checked) - ISO status unchanged.

name: North and East Syria (AANES/Rojava)
rule_summary: Until 2026 entry via Semalka used an AANES permit; crossings were handed to the Syrian state and visas issued at Semalka are now national.
notes: Rudaw 2026-04-18: Semalka under central government control. Row is a historical positive, now ended.

name: Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Oblast (GBAO)
rule_summary: All foreigners need a separate GBAO permit (via e-visa or OVIR) in addition to visa/visa-free entry; checked at oblast checkpoints.
notes: Wikipedia + Caravanistan + evisa guides agree; evisa.tj itself not read. Extra permits inside GBAO (Lake Sarez, Zorkul).

name: Turkmenistan restricted border zones (Dashoguz, Kerki, Hazar, Serakhs, Serhetabat etc.)
rule_summary: Foreigners need a special permit from the MFA/State Migration Service to visit listed border areas.
notes: Canadian government travel advice (search snippet), not Turkmen primary law.

name: Kinmen County
rule_summary: PRC nationals may get a 15-day entry permit on arrival if they stay only in Kinmen/Matsu/Penghu and arrive by boat at listed ports.
notes: NIA carrier guide PDF was unreadable. PRC side limits who may go (Fujian residents; Shanghai from April 2026).

name: Lienchiang County (Matsu)
rule_summary: Same permit on arrival, valid only for the offshore counties.

name: Penghu County
rule_summary: Same permit on arrival, valid only for the offshore counties.
notes: PRC exit endorsements currently reported only for Kinmen and Matsu.

name: Zanzibar
rule_summary: Own immigration checks on arrival from the mainland; since 2024-10-01 all visitors must buy Zanzibar-specific travel insurance.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Insurance mandate is a new territory-specific entry condition.

name: Crimea (AR Crimea and Sevastopol)
rule_summary: Ukrainian law: foreigners may enter only from mainland Ukraine with a special permit (CMU Resolution 367 of 2015-06-04); de facto, Russian visa rules apply.
notes: Ukrainian MFA consular pages exist (e.g. lithuania.mfa.gov.ua) but were not read. War-time; other Russian-occupied oblast parts are fluid and treated as emergency, not listed.

name: US Minor Outlying Islands (Midway, Wake, Johnston, Palmyra etc.)
rule_summary: Each island is closed to the public; entry needs a special use permit from US FWS and/or the US Air Force.
notes: One ISO code, several islands, all permit-only (no differential between them that matters for visits).

name: US Border Crossing Card zone
rule_summary: Mexican BCC holders may stay up to 30 days within a border band (25 mi; 55 mi in NM; 75 mi in AZ) without an I-94.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Artefact class: band defined by distance from border.

name: Niihau
rule_summary: Privately owned; access only by owner's invitation.
notes: Negative: private property, no public-law entry regime.

name: Vietnam coastal economic zones (legal class behind Phu Quoc)
rule_summary: Law 51/2019/QH14 allows visa exemption for entry into coastal economic zones that have an international airport and clear boundaries separated from the mainland, by Government decision.
affected_classes: all foreigners entering a designated zone
notes: Only Phu Quoc is known to be designated; Van Don / Con Dao not confirmed.

name: Phu Quoc Island
rule_summary: All foreign visitors arriving directly from abroad may stay 30 days visa-free if they remain on Phu Quoc.
notes: Prior sample row; not re-researched in this census. Legal class behind it: 2019 law amendment (Law 51/2019/QH14, in force 2020-07-01) allows visa exemption for qualifying coastal economic zones; see vn-coastal-economic-zones.

name: Socotra Archipelago
rule_summary: Tourists enter on a Socotra-only visa issued by the Socotra immigration office via a local sponsor (flights from Abu Dhabi); it is not valid for mainland Yemen.
notes: Tour-operator sources only (Koryo, Against the Compass); no official text. Events of Dec 2025-Jan 2026 in southern Yemen may have changed control - not checked.
